sources.title: Annex 1 - Town Centre Network
sources.verified_claim: The adopted London Plan Annex 1 classifies town centres by strategic role, night-time function and broad commercial/residential growth potential; network classification is strategic context rather than sample-parcel demand.

sources.title: Chapter 7 Heritage and Culture
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Policy HC6 supports diversified and well-managed night-time activity while balancing safety, noise, transport and resident impacts; policy does not establish the commercial viability of a sample parcel.

sources.title: 24 Hour London
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's 24 Hour London programme includes 2026 night-time initiatives, transport work and borough guidance; programme activity is city-wide support and does not prove parcel-level demand or licensing feasibility.

sources.title: Night Time Enterprise Zones
sources.verified_claim: The Night Time Enterprise Zone programme tests ways to extend high-street activity after 6pm and reports programme outcomes; historic or pilot performance is not automatically transferable to a sample parcel.

sources.title: Cultural services
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's cultural service links culture to town centres, new development and creative organisations; strategic cultural activity is borough context rather than evidence of a specific parcel's cultural use.

sources.title: Romford Masterplan
sources.verified_claim: Havering's Romford Masterplan consultation describes a strategic mixed-use town-centre framework intended to influence future development; a masterplan or consultation does not itself grant permission to a sample parcel.

sources.title: Minor Fact Change to Romford Masterplan
sources.verified_claim: Havering records approval of a minor fact change to the Romford Masterplan in May 2026; governance maintenance of the masterplan is not evidence of construction or demand at the sample parcel.

sources.title: Lambeth launches first ever night time economy strategy
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's first Night Time Economy Strategy sets measures for safer town centres, high-street activity, venue protection and worker support; strategy actions do not establish parcel-level demand, licensing or planning outcome.
